category: Register — which Sanskrit is being taught
label: the traditional ladder is ordered by grammar and text, and this inventory cannot measure it
note: Sanskrit-specific and deliberately UNCOVERED, because there is nothing in the corpus that could cover it and pretending otherwise would be the error. A pariksha syllabus asks for the śabda-rūpa and dhātu-rūpa tables, for sandhi rules by name, for samāsa analysis, and for a set text. The track teaches sandhi as a fact (SA-A1-C-05) and the noun families as a category (SA-A1-N-06), and it teaches NO paradigm table and NO text. Anybody who wants this file to speak to the traditional ladder has to build a second column, not extend this one.
